main_measure.name: mean of (forecast/10) x (next 20-bar return minus coin's mean 20-bar return) on grid bars with forecast > 0
main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm, mean < 0 with t <= -2 to reject, on at least 100 cases

supporting_check.name: book Calmar minus holding Calmar (before costs), passes if >= 0

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2 (or is undefined), meeting neither the confirm nor the reject rule.
reading: Situation checked on regime == 'trending' with forecast > 0; grid bars are positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window that have a bar 20 ahead in the same window; the coin's mean 20-bar return is the mean over all its grid samples in all windows; the book is postRebalance_total_value per bar, coins averaged per day, chained over windows w1..wN in order, and holding is the same from closes.
